AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

EnterpriseId.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise. Required when using [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property), ignored otherwise.

ReservationId.description: Reservation Id associated with the payment plan.

PaymentRequest.title: Payment plan payment request
PaymentRequest.description: Data related to the payment request associated with the payment plan created.

StartMonth.description: Specifies the month when the payment plan begins collecting payments, in the 'YYYY-MM' format. The month must be in the future and fall within the reservation period.
